mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_print_template (template_code, template_name, template_type, template_content, template_xml, template_json, template_fields, page_size, orientation, margin_top, margin_bottom, margin_left, margin_right, custom_css, header_html, footer_html, is_default, is_active, remark, create_user, create_time) VALUES (#{templateCode}, #{templateName}, #{templateType}, #{templateContent}, #{templateXml}, #{templateJson}, #{templateFields}, #{pageSize}, #{orientation}, #{marginTop}, #{marginBottom}, #{marginLeft}, #{marginRight}, #{customCss}, #{headerHtml}, #{footerHtml}, #{isDefault}, #{isActive}, #{remark}, #{createUser}, NOW())

when.test: templateType == 'APPLY' or templateType == 'PAYOUT' or templateType == 'APPLY_TYPE' or templateType == 'PAYOUT_TYPE'

choose.when: SELECT p.payout_id as payoutId, p.payout_billcode as payoutBillcode, p.bill_type as billType, p.emp_id as empId, p.emp_code as empCode, p.emp_name as empName, p.dept_id as deptId, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') as deptName, p.payout_type_id as payoutTypeId, p.apply_amount as applyAmount, p.apply_reason as applyReason, DATE_FORMAT(p.apply_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as applyDate, p.status, p.remark, DATE_FORMAT(p.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as createTime FROM ctrl_payout p LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON p.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE p.payout_billcode = #{businessKey}

SELECT pm.pact_id as pactId, pm.contract_no as contractNo, sd.dept_name as deptName, se.emp_name as empName, pm.contract_name as contractName, pm.contract_type as contractType, pm.party_a as partyA, pm.party_b as partyB, pm.contract_amount as contractAmount, DATE_FORMAT(pm.sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as signDate, DATE_FORMAT(pm.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as startDate, DATE_FORMAT(pm.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as endDate, pm.status, pm.remark, DATE_FORMAT(pm.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime FROM pact_main pm left join sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id=pm.dept_id left join sys_emp se on se.emp_id=pm.emp_id WHERE contract_no = #{businessKey}

SELECT ba.apply_id as applyId, ba.apply_no as applyNo, ba.budget_year as budgetYear, ba.item_id as itemId, ba.item_code as itemCode, ba.item_name as itemName, ba.subject_id as subjectId, ba.subject_code as subjectCode, ba.subject_name as subjectName, ba.apply_amount as applyAmount, ba.apply_reason as applyReason, ba.status, ba.applicant_id as applicantId, ba.applicant_code as applicantCode, ba.applicant_name as applicantName, ba.dept_id as deptId, ba.dept_code as deptCode, COALESCE(d.dept_name, ba.dept_name, '') as deptName, COALESCE(ba.applicant_phone, e.emp_phone, '') as applicantPhone, DATE_FORMAT(ba.apply_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as applyDate, DATE_FORMAT(ba.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, DATE_FORMAT(ba.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime FROM budget_apply ba LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON ba.applicant_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON ba.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE ba.apply_no = #{businessKey}

SELECT apam.id as id, apam.apply_no as applyNo, apam.apply_emp_id as applyEmpId, se.emp_name as empName, apam.apply_dept_id as applyDeptId, d.dept_name as deptName, apam.demand_date as demandDate, apam.apply_reason as applyReason, apam.apply_money as applyMoney, apam.status, apam.template_config_id as templateConfigId, DATE_FORMAT(apam.apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as applyTime, DATE_FORMAT(apam.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, DATE_FORMAT(apam.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime FROM asset_purchase_apply_main apam LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON apam.apply_dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_emp se on se.emp_id=apam.apply_emp_id WHERE apam.apply_no = #{businessKey}

SELECT a.apply_id as applyId, a.apply_no as applyNo, a.emp_id as empId, COALESCE(a.emp_code, e.emp_code, '') as empCode, COALESCE(a.emp_name, e.emp_name, '') as empName, COALESCE(a.emp_phone, e.emp_phone, '') as empPhone, COALESCE(a.dept_id, e.dept_id) as deptId, COALESCE(d.dept_name, a.dept_name, '') as deptName, a.hr_apply_type as hrApplyType, a.hr_apply_sub_type as hrApplySubType, DATE_FORMAT(a.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as endTime, a.supplement_id as supplementId, a.apply_day as applyDay, a.apply_reason as applyReason, a.main_attach_id as mainAttachId, a.status, a.template_config_id as templateConfigId, a.process_definition_id as processDefinitionId, a.process_instance_id as processInstanceId, a.remark, a.create_user as createUser, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime FROM hr_apply a LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON COALESCE(a.dept_id, e.dept_id) = d.dept_id WHERE a.apply_no = #{businessKey}

mapper.select: SELECT cpp.payment_id as paymentId, cpp.payout_id as payoutId, cpp.payment_amount as paymentAmount, cpp.payment_object as paymentObject, sc.code_name as paymentMethod, cpp.bank_name as bankName, cpp.bank_account as bankAccount, cpp.account_name as accountName, cpp.remark FROM ctrl_payout_payment cpp left join sys_code sc on cpp.payment_method = sc.code_value WHERE cpp.payout_id = #{payoutId} ORDER BY cpp.payment_id

SELECT invoice_id as invoiceId, payout_id as payoutId, invoice_code as invoiceCode, invoice_number as invoiceNumber, DATE_FORMAT(invoice_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as invoiceDate, invoice_amount as invoiceAmount, invoice_type as invoiceType, tax_amount as taxAmount, remark FROM ctrl_payout_invoice WHERE payout_id = #{payoutId} ORDER BY invoice_id

SELECT detail_id as detailId, budget_year as budgetYear, subject_id as subjectId, subject_code as subjectCode, subject_name as subjectName, item_id as itemId, item_code as itemCode, item_name as itemName, detail_type as detailType, amount, business_id as businessId, business_no as businessNo, dept_id as deptId, dept_code as deptCode, dept_name as deptName, emp_id as empId, emp_code as empCode, emp_name as empName, remark, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as createTime FROM budget_detail WHERE business_no = #{businessNo} ORDER BY detail_id

SELECT apad.id as id, apad.apply_id as applyId, apad.asset_code as assetCode, apad.asset_name as assetName, apad.spec as spec, apad.manufacturer as manufacturer, apad.unit as unit, apad.apply_quantity as applyQuantity, apad.price as price, apad.total_price as totalPrice, apad.remark as remark FROM asset_purchase_apply_detail apad INNER JOIN asset_purchase_apply_main apam ON apad.apply_id = apam.id WHERE apam.apply_no = #{applyNo} ORDER BY apad.id
